title: Pregnant Mother Simulator
description:
The simulator of a pregnant mother allows you to fully experience the whole process of pregnancy.
In this anime game you have to play the role of a girl who has a loving husband and a child under her heart, who is waiting for her birth. Take care of yourself, give birth, take care of your baby and raise a healthy baby.

You will feel all the difficulties of a pregnant woman's life. Take care of the mother and the child to keep health and well-being under control.

Features of the game:
- Brisk walking and other exercises for pregnant women for mom.
- Smooth and easy operation.
- A mother's game that will carry out her daily activities after pregnancy.

title: Build an Aquapark
description:
🎢 Welcome to the craziest water park! 💦

Build your own dream water slide and ride it at full speed! Buy parts, combine them however you like, and create the longest, fastest, and craziest tracks in the game.

title: ASMR Girl: Livestream Mukbang
description:
ASMR Girl: Livestream Mukbang is a casual food game where you are the star of a mukbang stream. You get to enjoy delicious dishes, interact with your audience, and grow your popularity with every bite, all on camera! Each meal takes you closer to becoming even more popular, so keep eating, keep engaging, and watch your virtual foodie journey unfold.
How to Play ASMR Girl: Livestream Mukbang
Relaxing, fun, and super engaging, ASMR Girl: Livestream Mukbang lets you enjoy cooking, eating, and styling in a way that’s not only entertaining but also rewarding. Keep streaming, earning, and upgrading to become the most popular mukbang star! Become a livestream star with your channel, serving up drinks, dishes, and endless ASMR satisfaction. There are a few livestreams that you’ll participate in to get as many likes and hearts as possible from your fans.
Curate Your Stream
Start with a drink, pick your glass from thin-rimmed, stemmed, and rounded, and then add ice cubes in shapes from classic squares to cute bears. Garnish with fruits like lime, kiwi, or raspberry (some unlock as you earn rewards). Choose your syrup, give it a shake, add a straw, and get ready to sip your way into livestream fame. But beware — a boring drink could mean negative feedback!
Dig In on Camera
Once the drinks are done, move on to food. Eat tempura, sundaes, ramen, chicken, lobster, and even mix them in one stream for bigger rewards. The more fun and satisfying the experience, the more your audience grows. Once your food is ready, it’s time to go live! Eat, chat, and interact with your viewers as you enjoy the food. Your realistic ASMR sounds will make the experience feel so satisfying that your viewers won’t want to miss a moment. Engage with fans and watch your audience grow!
Go to the Supermarket
Start by shopping for ingredients, then move on to cooking mouth-watering dishes! From spicy noodles to delicious seafood and even sweet treats, the possibilities are endless. Prepare a meal that will make your audience hungry for more! For some of your livestreams, you get to shop for snacks and treats like sushi, dumplings, candy, and ice cream, but don’t get brain freeze! Pay with your card, stock up, and get ready to stream again.
Cook, Stream, and Engage
Shop for ingredients, cook delicious meals, then go live. Eat, chat, and interact while your realistic ASMR sounds keep viewers hooked. Successful streams bring in money. Spend it on stylish outfits for your character, or unlock even more mouth-watering food to keep your audience entertained.
If you’re a livestream fan, this game can get quite addictive. The more successful your streams, the more money you make. Use your earnings to upgrade your girl’s outfits, giving her a stylish and trendy appearance. You can also buy even more delicious food to satisfy your growing audience and keep the mukbang going!


Controls:
Desktop: Right-click on buttons, move the mouse to rotate.
Mobile: Tap on buttons, swipe your finger to rotate.

Key Features:
• Plenty of Food: Discover a wide variety of dishes to suit every taste! Try them all and showcase them to your audience!
• Interactive: Visit restaurants for delicious treats or head to the supermarket to pick out your favorite dishes. Scan items at the checkout and pay with your card! And that's not all. You can even prepare some delicacies yourself! Skewer fruits and berries and coat them in caramel glaze. A perfect dessert for your mukbang!
• Decorate Your Home: Choose furniture, flooring, walls, and other details for your home! Mukbangs need to be filmed in a cozy setting!

Game Modes:
• Dining: Head to a café and select delicacies for your mukbang!
• Minimart: Go shopping at the supermarket! Pick something tasty and showcase it on your stream!

Core Gameplay & Story
Q: What is the goal of the game?
A: You play as a mukbang streamer! Eat delicacies live on stream, gain new subscribers and likes, enjoy new tasty treats, and build your popularity with your audience!

Q: What grabs attention in the first minutes?
A: A plethora of delicious options! You’ll find a variety of tasty dishes here, from sweets and drinks to hot fish or meat dishes. Takoyaki, onigiri, caramel-coated berries, and much more—there will definitely be plenty to eat on your stream and show to your viewers!

Mechanics & Progression
Q: How many levels are there / is the structure clear?
A: The game flows seamlessly. Days pass one after another, and with each new day, your subscribers will grow, and you'll earn more money!

Q: What unlocks as you play?
A: Unlock new foods and modes. Surprise your viewers with new dishes, and of course, try them out yourself!

Economy & Customization
Q: What can you buy/upgrade?
A: Purchase new food at the store, but you can also visit restaurants to choose treats there! You can even make drinks and some desserts yourself!

Q: Are there skins/customization options?
A: Your viewers will love to see you in new outfits. Choose a costume from the skin shop and stream your mukbang in style! You can also change not just your character's skin but also the table or walls in your room! Diversify your background!

Q: What is available from the start?
A: Right from the start, you will make drinks for your first mukbang! Pour a cocktail of your choice, add selected ingredients, mix well, and see what you’ve created!

Retention & Engagement
Q: Are there daily tasks / a wheel of fortune / achievements / tasks?
A: Yes! Spin the wheel of fortune and win prizes! You won’t be disappointed. You’re sure to get something worthwhile!

Q: Is sound necessary?
A: You can play as you like. But with sound, you’ll immerse yourself better in the cozy atmosphere of the game!

Q: What achievements are there and how can you earn them?
A: Stream and post updates, collect clips from your mukbangs, and cherish the wonderful moments!

Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What is it like?
A: The game is intuitive from the first seconds. It will guide you through all the mechanics and show you how to play without unnecessary text.

title: Cooking Empire
description:
🍔 Cooking Empire is not just a cooking game, it’s a real explosion of flavors and speed! 🍟 Start frying, boiling, baking and serving dishes from all over the world with one click! Are you ready to become a chef the whole world will remember? 🍳

👨‍🍳 Turn an ordinary kitchen into the epicenter of culinary fever! Cook tom yum, serve juicy burgers, cook foie gras and surprise guests with exotic recipes. The goal is simple: create your own culinary empire, where every visitor is a happy gourmet! 🔥

✈️ Travel through the flavors of the planet!
Discover the aromas of Paris, the fire of Beijing, the warmth of Rome and the taste of Moscow. Dozens of cities, hundreds of restaurants and thousands of recipes are waiting for you - from classics to hidden delicacies! Want to bake, fry, boil and experiment? Welcome to Cooking Empire!

title: Idle Vlogger Simulator
description:
Step into the shoes of a rising digital star in this comprehensive content creator simulation. Your core gameplay loop revolves around planning, recording, and editing videos to maximize your views and subscriber count. Start by selecting trending themes like gaming, memes, or tech, then fine-tune your recording style by balancing visuals versus conversation and choosing a tone that resonates with your audience. Once the footage is captured, head into the editing suite to arrange clips, add transitions, and apply text effects to boost your video's quality and viral potential.

Controls:
Desktop: Click the buttons with the right mouse button.
Mobile: Tap the buttons.

Key Features:
• Earn rewards! : Achieve special milestones to earn rewards, such as the Silver Button for reaching your first 100,000 subscribers. Just like in real life!
• Upgrade your team and equipment. : Working with a team makes things easier! Hire your team and strive for popularity together! But don’t forget that equipment is important too — upgrade it!
Choose your video theme! Film on topics that you enjoy the most or that are currently trending! Pick what resonates with you: video games, memes, and more. But don’t limit yourself — you can change themes whenever you want!

Upgrades / Progression / Economy:
• Upgrade your equipment. : Improve it with money to enhance the quality of your videos!
• Upgrade your team! : Enhance your team with video coins to improve the quality of new videos!

Levels / Maps / Worlds:
• Old House.: Your first home. This is where you start!
• Penthouse.: Level up to a penthouse! This is an elite home fit for a popular blogger!

Characters / Heroes / Skins:
• Cute streamer: A charming streamer who captures the hearts of viewers. A great skin if you want to take on that role!
• Gaming blogger: Love video games and videos about them? A perfect skin for recording gaming content!

Power-ups / Abilities:
• AFK profit bonus: Allows you to earn money while in AFK mode. Relax and reap the rewards!
• 2X views bonus: Doubles the views on your videos!

Story / Setting:
Immerse yourself in the life of a blogger. Record videos on various topics and hire your team to create content!

Core Gameplay & Story
Q: What is the goal of the game?
A: Become a blogger! Create new videos on different topics, gain subscribers and views. Earn more money and improve the quality of new videos and your room!

Q: Is there a storyline?
A: You are a blogger. Create more videos, hire a team, and interact with colleagues — they will help you with advice at the start!

Q: What grabs you in the first minutes?
A: The ability to record videos on various topics and upgrade your equipment and team! An engaging blogger simulator where you can fully immerse yourself in the role!

Mechanics & Progression
Q: How can I level up faster?
A: Create higher quality videos and upgrade your team. They will help you make better videos and earn more subscribers, views, and of course, money!

Q: What unlocks as you play?
A: You will be able to upgrade your living space — from an old house to your own castle!

Economy & Customization
Q: What can you buy/upgrade?
A: The game offers many upgrade options. Improve your equipment, upgrade your team — they will assist you in producing new videos, and buy a new house!

Q: Are there skins/customization options?
A: Yes! You have flexible customization options: from changing your house to naming your own channel and your blogger's skin!

Q: What is available from the start?
A: At the start, you can name your channel and choose 2 skins for your blogger, as well as the theme for your new videos!

Retention & Engagement
Q: Are there daily rewards/wheel of fortune/achievements/tasks?
A: Earn daily rewards with currency and bonuses, and spin the wheel of fortune for a chance to win a rare skin!

Q: Are there leaderboards and how do they work?
A: Release more videos and become more popular by earning views and subscribers. This will get you onto the leaderboard!

Q: Is sound necessary?
A: Play however you prefer! Sound is not mandatory.

Q: What achievements are there and how can you earn them?
A: The game features various challenges. Complete specific conditions to earn rewards in the form of video coins and new subscribers. You can also earn rewards, such as the "Silver Button" for your first 100,000 subscribers.

Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What is it like?
A: At the beginning of the game, you will be shown how a blogger's work is structured, so you will quickly understand everything from there!

title: Solar Smash
description:
Solar Smash is a fun game that allows you to fully embrace cosmic power and create or destroy planets as you wish. You can choose from a variety of different weapons and use them to destroy planets and moons. Additionally, you can create your own planetary systems and customize them as you wish.

Solar Smash is also an opportunity to unleash your creativity and create worlds or destroy them in your hands. You can tear apart planets, cause supernovas and create black holes that consume everything in their path. The game has intuitive controls that are suitable for both beginners and experienced players.

Overall, Solar Smash is an addictive game that allows you to harness cosmic power and create or destroy planets at will. If you love physics simulators and space, then this game is definitely for you!

title: Idle Game Dev Simulator
description:
Become the Ultimate Game Developer!
Start from a small garage and build your way up to a legendary game studio in Idle Game Dev Simulator — the ultimate idle tycoon for every gamer and creator at heart!

Create hit games, upgrade your studio, hire the best talent, and research cutting-edge technologies to dominate the gaming industry. Every tap brings you closer to success… or another flop.

CREATE. INNOVATE. DOMINATE.
Mix genres, choose themes, and pick the perfect platform to craft the next big hit. Strategy, arcade, or adventure — your creativity is the key to success. Analyze reviews, track ratings, and evolve your studio to become a true legend of game development.

UPGRADE YOUR STUDIO. GROW YOUR EMPIRE.
From a dusty laptop in your garage to a sleek high-tech office buzzing with talent — unlock new rooms, features, and upgrades. Automate production, research advanced mechanics, and push your limits to the top of the charts!

title: Car Crash Sandbox
description:
Realistic High-Speed Car Crash Simulator

Launch vehicles down massive slopes and crash them into destructible obstacles. Experience high-speed collisions, realistic crash physics, and detailed vehicle damage in an online driving simulator.

Crash cars. Break parts. Feel the impact.

Choose from multiple vehicles and watch them deform, crumble, and break apart with realistic physics and damage simulation.

Features:
- Online multiplayer mode
- Realistic car deformation physics
- 3D graphics
- Authentic driving controls
- Detailed vehicle damage system
- Multiple vehicles to choose from

title: Beam Drive Car Crash Test Simulator
description:
Dive into the exhilarating world of car crashes with the Beam Drive Car Crash Test Simulator. Perfect for those who love realistic car destruction and high-speed racing, this free online game is accessible on both mobile and PC. Prepare for an entertaining experience filled with destruction physics!

Controls:
Desktop: WASD — movement, right mouse button to click buttons, ZX — left and right turn signals. Mouse wheel — zoom in/out camera, left mouse button — rotate camera.
Mobile: Tap the buttons. Left/right buttons, accelerate forward, reverse.

Key Features:
• Realistic controls: The game features highly accurate controls, along with vehicle destructibility. Watch as cars crumple, tear apart, and explode into pieces!
• Create your own levels: If the basic maps aren't enough for you, create your own — you decide what will be on your map and how it will look!
• Choose your car: Pick the car you like and hit the road! Wonder how long your journey will be.

Game Modes:
• Classic mode: A classic mode where you can play on 8 ready-made maps and test the cars!
• Map Editor: A separate large world where you can create your own maps as your heart desires. Come up with your own challenges and obstacles or just create something unique.

Vehicles / Cars:
• Caro: A powerful muscle car. It will impress you with its speed and power. See how it withstands obstacles in its path!
• Flash: The futuristic electric car! Powerful and fast enough. Watch how it takes a hit!
• Syper: A sports car designed specifically for speed. Street racing is its forte, but how will it perform on the map? Find out!

Core Gameplay & Story
Q: What is the goal of the game?
A: Test the cars' durability by completing challenges, or create your own! It's your sandbox where you can play as you wish! Choose a car and go racing on the map! You can complete challenges or immediately destroy your car on the first obstacle! Watch as cars turn into heaps of metal, or try to keep them intact. The choice is yours!

Q: How do you win / what counts as losing?
A: This is your sandbox where you set the rules. Destroy cars and enjoy watching them explode, or try to keep them whole!

Q: What grabs attention in the first minutes?
A: Realistic controls and driving physics allow for realistic scenarios. You can turn on the turn signal, honk, and even get out of the car or drive from a first-person perspective, witnessing all the chaos from inside! A wide selection of maps lets you play out numerous scenarios!

Mechanics & Progression
Q: How many levels are there / is the structure clear?
A: There are 8 maps in the game, each differing in challenges and content. But if that's not enough, you can create your own map in the map editor! You're not limited in possible scenarios!

Q: What unlocks as you play?
A: Unlock new cars and test their durability! See how many challenges they can withstand.

Economy & Customization
Q: Are there skins / customization?
A: Paint the cars in your desired color and see how they perform on the map!

Q: What is available from the start?
A: Most cars in the game are available from the start. Begin your journey with the car you like!

Retention & Engagement
Q: Is sound necessary?
A: Sound is not mandatory, but it can enhance the emotional experience!

Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What does it entail?
A: At the beginning of the game, you'll be taught how to control the car, and from the first seconds, you'll understand what to do!

title: 3D Acrylic Nail: Nail Art Game

Design stunning acrylic nails with trendy styles, vibrant colors, and charming accessories. Satisfy your customers' unique requests, earn money, and upgrade your salon to become the best nail stylist in town!

title: My Pet Care Salon: Obby Dress-Up 3D
description:
Welcome to a cute pet care salon!
In this casual simulation game, you run your own animal care salon. Wash your pets, take care of them, decorate them, and train them so they become happier and healthier.

Complete simple tasks, upgrade your salon, and unlock new features. Every pet needs attention and care. The game offers relaxing gameplay, a cozy atmosphere, and lots of adorable moments with lovely pets.

Perfect for players who love animals and calm casual games.

title: Flufflings: Pocket Pets
description:
Take care of stray kittens and create a cozy home and yard for them!

🧸 Buy toys and decorations: Make your space even more appealing to the cats.
🍲 Attract cats with food: The more food and toys, the more fluffy guests you'll get!
😊 Earn coins: The happier a cat is when it leaves, the more rewards it will leave behind.
🏠 Adopt kittens: Put a collar on a cat to make it stay forever.
🔍 Learn about the cats: Hold a cat to see its characteristics.
🍽️ Fill the bowls: Simply drop food or water into the bowl.
🎾 Play with the cats: Drag and release the ball to play.
🚪 Control the flow of visitors: Click the gate to stop new cats from visiting.

title: SHADOW NODE
description:
Welcome to Shadow Node – the ultimate hacker idle experience.

You are an elite hacker on a mission to infiltrate global networks, breach high-security servers, and mine valuable data fragments. Your ultimate goal? The legendary Shadow Node—a network so secretive it is only spoken of in whispers on the deepest dark web forums.

Are you ready to bring the digital world to its knees?

FEATURES
Progressive Hacking Network
Work your way up from simple local networks to complex government databases. Every successful hack brings you closer to the top of the digital food chain.

Idle Gameplay: Your Botnet Never Sleeps
Progress even while you’re offline. Your scripts automatically gather data fragments while you're away. Return to collect massive rewards—perfect for hackers on the go.

Deep Upgrade System
Invest in cutting-edge hacking tools, AI assistants, massive botnets, and quantum processors. Optimize your mining rate with hundreds of unique upgrades.

Strategic Prestige System
Perform a strategic reset to unlock permanent bonuses and multipliers. Plan your ascension carefully to exponentially increase your earning potential.

Immersive Cyberpunk Atmosphere
Experience an atmospheric soundtrack and a dark aesthetic designed to pull you deep into the world of cybercrime.

Fully Customizable: Tweak visual effects, haptic feedback, and choose from multiple languages.
Mobile Optimized: Smooth gameplay and intuitive touch controls.

Leave no trace. Download Shadow Node now and begin your ascent to hacker stardom!

title: Black Hole: Eat the Universe
description:
Tap to feed a hungry black hole. Devour atoms, then planets, stars, and whole galaxies. Upgrade your pull, unlock skins and hats, spin for boosts, and collapse the universe to bank Dark Matter — then grow back faster. How big can your void get?

title: Idle Zoo Tycoon
description: Build and manage your dream zoo in Idle Zoo Tycoon! Start with a small park and grow it into a massive wildlife attraction filled with animals from around the world. Earn coins even while you're offline, upgrade habitats, unlock rare species, and expand your zoo to attract more visitors. title: Bad Cat Prankster - Mom's Return
description:

Hit slimes to collect drops, sell them for coins, unlock new eggs, upgrade your farm, and discover even more unique slimes.

title: Construction Set - 3D Builder

Challenge your skills, unleash your imagination, and watch your architectural masterpieces come to life. Let your creativity flow as you construct and unwind.

Mix and match tops, dresses, hairstyles, shoes, and accessories to create cozy, cheerful outfits. title: My resale. Cases and sales

My Phone Store is a fun and casual game about creating and selling tech devices!
Build smartphones, laptops, and tablets, improve your production, and sell devices to customers. Grow your shop, earn money, and turn a small store into a successful electronics business.

title: Car Sales Empire Simulator
description:
Step into the dynamic realm of Car Sales Empire Simulator, where you can build a successful automotive business. Master car trading and repairs, hone your strategy, and enjoy smooth gameplay on any device while fostering your enterprise and enjoying thrilling negotiations.

Controls:
Desktop: WASD, arrow keys, click mouse to select an option, C to crouch.  
Mobile: built-in joystick, tap to select an option.

Game Modes:
• Graphics: Low: A less resource-intensive mode for the device, with fewer details, nuances, and volume in light-shadow rendering.  
• Graphics: High: A deeper contrast of light and shadow, more details, and greater load on the device.

Core Gameplay & Story  
Q: What is the goal of the game?  
A: Buy cars and upgrade them to sell later. The higher the sales, the more opportunities arise. It's a great chance to showcase creativity by choosing designs and tuning, improve your online driving skills by maneuvering cars through the city without accidents, and develop the best sales strategy to expand your dealership.

Q: What grabs your attention in the first few minutes?  
A: The atmosphere of the city, the ability to not just move between locations but to weave through the hustle of urban traffic, and the vast opportunities for growth and creativity captivate from the very start.

Mechanics & Progression  
Q: What opens up as you progress in the game?  
A: As you play, more opportunities arise to purchase more expensive cars and parts. There’s always a chance to find a true rare gem of the automotive industry.

Q: How can you level up faster?  
A: Lower the price when buying to maximize your profit from deals.

Economy & Customization  
Q: What is available from the very start?  
A: Buying your first car is easy! 7000 in-game dollars await you upon your first launch. Don’t forget to keep a little reserve for tuning.

Retention & Engagement  
Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What does it include?  
A: The onboarding guides you through all the necessary scenarios, immersing you in the game in a careful and clear manner.

Q: Are there daily quests / a wheel of fortune / achievements / tasks?  
A: Complete quests and earn rewards in the form of in-game dollars to buy the most interesting cars faster.
